title: A foundational GeoAI model for Nepal's Sustainable Development Goals
stage: In development · seeking partners and funding
summary: A geospatial foundation model pre-trained on multi-sensor, multi-year satellite imagery of the Terai, hills and mountains, adapted with few local labels to map crops, rangelands, forests, urban growth and hazards for SDG reporting.
partners: Open to universities, government agencies and NGOs in Nepal

title: Explainable AI for satellite monitoring of vegetation health
summary: Interpretable models for satellite image time series that track grassland dynamics and vegetation health and show which bands, seasons and features drive each prediction, so that land managers can trust and act on the results.
partners: Open to research and industry partners

title: Drone monitoring for Nepal's smallholder farms
summary: Open, labelled drone datasets for Nepal's main crops, lightweight models that run on phones and drones, and simple flight protocols for agricultural extension workers.
partners: Farmer cooperatives, agricultural colleges and research stations
links: Read: what drones can (and can't yet) do

title: Multi-modal disaster risk mapping
summary: Combining satellite and drone imagery with socio-economic indicators to map flood and landslide hazards, and the people and assets exposed to them, for disaster preparedness and sustainability planning.

title: Open language resources for Nepali and code-mixed text
summary: Extending the NepEMO dataset into a wider set of open Nepali benchmarks, and building small, efficient models for Devanagari, Roman Nepali and code-mixed text.
partners: Universities and language communities in Nepal

title: Drones and AI to improve crop quality and quantity
summary: Multispectral drone imaging and machine learning to estimate crop disease severity and yield, including a cooperative scheme of vegetation indices for peanut late leaf spot (R² up to about 0.79) and reviews of drones for precision agriculture.

title: Deep-learning weed mapping from drone images
summary: Multi-class weed segmentation in a cotton field from 201 drone images; a UNet model with an EfficientNetB0 backbone reached an F1-score of 88%.

title: BotanicX-AI: explainable plant disease detection
summary: A deep-learning model that identifies ten tomato leaf conditions with 99% test accuracy and explains each decision with Grad-CAM and LIME.

title: NepEMO: emotions in Nepali Reddit
summary: An open, manually labelled dataset of 4,462 Nepali Reddit posts (2019–2025) with five emotions and three sentiment classes, in English, Roman Nepali, Devanagari and code-mixed text.
